provision.title: Provision New Consumer
provision.resultIntro: {{node}} registered. Run the command below as root on the NEW server:
provision.step1: Run the command on the new consumer server — it sets up read-only OpenLDAP replication automatically.
provision.step2: When done, the node self-registers and appears 'online' here.
provision.securityNote: The command contains the certificate + replication password; transmit securely, do not share.
provision.formNote: The new server is installed as a pure OpenLDAP consumer (read-only replica). The replication password is fetched automatically from the master; a cert is generated and a one-time install command is returned.
